text:
Evan (Finance): Heads-up: updated vendor approval flow and spend tags going into effect next Monday. Main changes: vendor approvals for recurring spend >= $2,500/month; single invoices >= $7,500 require PO+approval. Please read the short checklist: https://intra.redwood.com/procurement/checklist :memo:

Maya (Procurement): Practical notes: use the Vendor Onboard form for any new vendor (link above). For contractor SaaS seats under $1k/month, you can use the card if vendor already approved. If unsure, email procure@redwood.com with vendor name + estimate. :email:

Omar (Eng): For evaluation GPUs (usually billed monthly) this will push many to the PO flow. Is there a fast-track for short POCs?

Maya (Procurement): Yes, POC fast-track exists: include expected duration and capped spend in the onboard form and mark "PO requested: POC". We can issue short-term POs (60 days) once security signs off.

Sofia (Legal): Reminder: any contract that includes data access, model hosting, or access to prod infra must attach the Contract Intake form. No signatures until Legal confirms. Use: https://intra.redwood.com/contract-intake :scroll:

Priya (Product): Example tagging format Finance wants in expenses/POs so we map to product lines: 

```
project=redwood-optimize
deployment=dedicated
cost_center=product-ops
```

SpendBot: Auto-check: invoices without project tag will be auto-flagged. Missing PO for invoices >= 7500 will queue an AP hold.

Evan (Finance): Quick timeline: policy effective Mon. We'll run a reminder on Friday and host a 20-min Q&A Friday 4pm PT. If you have a pending vendor, start the proc req this week.

Omar (Eng): Thanks  will scope our POC and submit fast-track request. :thumbsup:

Maya (Procurement): TL;DR: recurring >= $2500/mo or single invoice >= $7500 -> PO + procurement approval; tag everything; use onboard/contract intake links; fast-track for POCs available. Ping procure@redwood.com for help.
